CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-001.say: People see you as strong, composed and competent, with vibrant energy, and know you cannot be easily swayed. You admire courage.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-002.say: You come across as friendly, approachable and soft, and people see you as a gentle, safe haven.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-003.say: You come across as vibrant, charming, witty and inspiring, and you easily become the centre of attention.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-004.say: You put your family above all and act as its caretaker and guardian, though your family may overlook your efforts.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-005.say: You bring fresh ideas, quick wit and charm, and social gatherings come alive in your presence.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-006.say: You come across as understanding and compassionate, and people see you as warm and fair. Those who need support are drawn to you.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-007.say: You carry an air of mystery and uniqueness and are seen as serious, studious and independent. Your intelligence earns respect.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-008.say: You give off strength, power and natural authority, which can impress or even intimidate. You attract resourceful people.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-009.say: You carry yourself with dignity and a noble, aristocratic air, and you control your own image well.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-010.say: You are highly perceptive, creative and intellectual, and people see you as gentle and intellectual.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-011.say: You come across as dependable and steadfast, and people see you as a pillar of any business.

CHALDEAN-PERSONALITY-012.say: You inspire confidence and have a fine sense of justice. You keep harmony around you, even at the cost of your own desires.
